title: Monotonicity of the threshold sign
statement: Let $r,s\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $r\le s$. For $sigma(t)=1$ when $t\ge0$ and $sigma(t)=-1$ when $t<0$, one has $sigma(r)\lesigma(s)$.
replaced:
Let $r,s\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $r\le s$, and define $\sigma(t)=1$ when $t\ge0$ and
$\sigma(t)=-1$ when $t<0$.
Then $\sigma(r)\le\sigma(s)$.
